data: What are the scales used for the size of subspace and size of lexicon axes respectively?

The top graph shows the correlation values on the y-axis ranging from 0 to 0.8, while the x-axis represents the size of the subspace. The bottom graph also shows the correlation values on the y-axis ranging from 0.3 to 0.7, but the x-axis represents the size of the lexicon. Therefore, the scale for the size of the subspace is logarithmic, and the scale for the size of the lexicon is linear.
